data.narrative:
Chai Discovery is a Series C–stage biotech company founded by Joshua Meier (former Chief AI Officer at Absci, Meta/FAIR protein language modeling researcher) and Jack Dent (ex-Stripe). The company currently carries a $3.8B post-money valuation following $400M in total raised capital. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 11 comparable companies: 3 public (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private firms in Biotech & Health, including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), New Limit ($3.1B), and publicly traded peers Recursion Pharmaceuticals ($1.6B), Freenome ($1.1B), and Alto Neuroscience ($1.0B).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x multiplier typical for Series C advancement, yielding $6.5B. Peer-median analysis across the 5-company comparable set (valuation range $1.0B–$10.3B) implies $1.6B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied; while the Biotech & Health sector median trades at 7.4x revenue across the 3 public tickers, Chai's private-company status precludes reliable revenue disclosure.

These methods support a triangulated range of $1.4B (low) to $7.4B (high), with a median of $4.0B. The current $3.8B valuation sits near the median, though significant dispersion across peer multiples—particularly the $10.3B outlier—reflects uncertainty in growth trajectory and clinical-stage risk. Key variables include undisclosed revenue metrics, clinical progress, and whether Chai's AI-first founding team commands a premium relative to traditional biotech comparables.
